WITH tmp1 AS (
    SELECT i_manager_id, SUM(ss_sales_price) AS sum_sales
    FROM item 
    JOIN store_sales ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ss_store_sk = s_store_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_month_seq BETWEEN 1222 AND 1332
    WHERE ((i_category IN ('Books', 'Children', 'Electronics') AND i_class IN ('personal', 'portable', 'reference', 'self-help') AND i_brand IN ('scholaramalgamalg #14', 'scholaramalgamalg #7', 'exportiunivamalg #9', 'scholaramalgamalg #9'))
           OR (i_category IN ('Women', 'Music', 'Men') AND i_class IN ('accessories', 'classical', 'fragrances', 'pants') AND i_brand IN ('amalgimporto #1', 'edu packscholar #1', 'exportiimporto #1', 'importoamalg #1')))
    GROUP BY i_manager_id
)
SELECT * FROM tmp1 
WHERE ABS(sum_sales - (SELECT AVG(sum_sales) FROM tmp1)) / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(sum_sales) FROM tmp1), 0) > 0.1
ORDER BY i_manager_id, (SELECT AVG(sum_sales) FROM tmp1), sum_sales
LIMIT 100
